data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'amare,' meaning 'to love.' The suffix '-ette' denotes a diminutive or little one, making Amarette a name that signifies a love so sweet and precious as honey. The name Amarette carries the meaning “Sweet as honey” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Amarette usually hope their child will grow to embody sweet as honey and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_latin.name: Amaretta
in_latin.long_meaning: Amaretta - Derivatum est a verbo 'amare', quod amoris significat. In cultura christiana, amare significat caritatem et benignitatem. Amaretta, nomen femininum, potest referre ad feminam qui caritatem et benignitatem habet.
